summary: BridgeBio Pharma filed a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that on October 6, 2026 it issued a press release announcing FDA acceptance and Priority Review of its NDA for oral infigratinib in children with achondroplasia, with a PDUFA target action date of February 4, 2027. The registrant is the sponsor and filer; no securities transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are stated. This is a routine regulatory-milestone disclosure, not a special situation; pipeline and approval-timeline risk is the only watch item.
